svg.title: How a permission request is decided

g.text: Ask in TUI, save on always allow
A deny in an individual rule wins in any order, and always allow cannot override it
If the matching rule or the mode default is allow, it is allowed at once
Even when the value is ask, a saved always allow that matches is allowed without asking
With no saved allow either, the request is held until the answer arrives, and choosing always allow saves it
